dedupe_keys.name: pypsa de german energy system model

description: PyPSA-DE is the Ariadne project's sector-coupled model of Germany's energy system, built on PyPSA and PyPSA-Eur. It contains a reproducible workflow that combines German plant, grid-development and sector-demand sources and solves a linear capacity-expansion and operation problem. Outputs include solved networks, energy balances, investments and emissions. Coverage includes Germany, its electricity neighbours, Italy and Spain; the default aggregation uses 16 German and 13 surrounding regions. Time resolution follows the scenario configuration. Python source is free under MIT, while input datasets have separate terms. A limitation is that local network inconsistencies can create unrealistic load shedding or curtailment without appropriate clustering. The model supports electricity and hydrogen infrastructure planning and sector-coupling studies. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is its underlying library. The README links the Ariadne climate-neutrality report and a separate deposit of solved networks, which remains a distinct data lead.
inputs: German energy-system inventories, demands and network plans
name: PyPSA-DE German energy-system model
